title: Mishneh Torah, Hilchot Melachim
description: Maimonides' 12th-century legal code; *Hilchot Melachim* 11:1 sets out the principal Maimonidean position on the messianic age and the rebuilding of the Temple. The standard classical Jewish-legal reference for the Third Temple expectation the corpus engages around the embassy's identification with the Third Temple.

cited_by.title: The Book Closest to the Truth
